attchmntText: MITCON Consultancy & Engineering Services Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: MITCON Consultancy and Engineering Services Limited has published its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results during its meeting held on November 06, 2026. The company published the financial results in the Financial Express and the Loksatta Marathi daily Pune Edition on November 07, 2026. This intimation is submitted pursuant to Regulation 47 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. Copies of the newspaper publications are enclosed with the notice.

attchmntText: MITCON Consultancy & Engineering Services Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
